title: Kingdom: New Lands
provenance: Reported by Jester1397 (upstream#212, 2026-09-26), Apple M3, macOS 27.0, KLYC-Box 0.9.35, engine x64-sikarugir10.0_6-r7, DXVK, the Epic Games version, about two hours through the first two islands. Not verified by the maintainer.
notes: Unity. Reported playable on DXVK from the Epic Games version, two islands in about two hours, with occasional freezes and slightly laggy sound. Nothing was measured here. The game has a native Mac version on Steam as well.

knownIssues.symptom: Occasional freezes during play and slightly laggy sound (reported on an M3, DXVK, engine r7).
knownIssues.fix: none known, the reporter played through them.
